## Global options

These options belong to `veritas` itself and apply to every command. Put them before or after the command name.

| Option                  | Description                                                                                                  | Values         | Default           |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------- | ----------------- |
| `-V, --version`         | output the version number                                                                                    |                |                   |
| `--json`                | print machine-readable JSON on stdout; logs go to stderr                                                     |                |                   |
| `-C, --root <dir>`      | project root                                                                                                 |                | current directory |
| `--allow-code-config`   | allow loading veritas.config.{ts,js,mjs}, which executes project code                                        |                |                   |
| `--debug`               | log child processes, restricted calls of project code, stages and cache use to stderr (also VERITAS_DEBUG=1) |                |                   |
| `--log-format <format>` | stderr log format: text, or json (one object per line)                                                       | `text`, `json` | `text`            |

## Commands

| Command            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `veritas init`     | detect the project and write .veritas/config.json                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `veritas doctor`   | check tools, credentials and the restricted runner for project code; report disabled/degraded features                                                                                                                  |
| `veritas discover` | collect specification evidence                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `veritas spec`     | review the property registry                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `veritas analyze`  | index code and tests, map them to properties and assess tests                                                                                                                                                           |
| `veritas mutate`   | run mutation testing and relate mutants to properties                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `veritas test`     | property-based tests                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `veritas prove`    | verify formalized properties with an SMT solver (bounded)                                                                                                                                                               |
| `veritas improve`  | plan test-only improvements (dry run, the default) or apply an approved plan in an isolated copy; exit 0 plan ready/improved, 4 no safe improvement or spec decision needed, 1 blocked, 2 bad token or CI, 3 tool error |
| `veritas report`   | print the latest results                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `veritas run`      | run the full pipeline                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `veritas replay`   | re-run a previous run with the same stages and options                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `veritas explain`  | show the evidence chain of a finding                                                                                                                                                                                    |

### `veritas init`

detect the project and write .veritas/config.json

```text
veritas init [options]
```

| Option      | Description                                        | Values | Default |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------- |
| `-y, --yes` | non-interactive: accept the detected configuration |        |         |
| `--force`   | overwrite an existing configuration                |        |         |
| `--dry-run` | print the configuration without writing            |        |         |

### `veritas doctor`

check tools, credentials and the restricted runner for project code; report disabled/degraded features

```text
veritas doctor
```

### `veritas discover`

collect specification evidence

```text
veritas discover [options]
```

| Option                       | Description                                                                                   | Values | Default |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------- |
| `--offline`                  | Veritas makes no network requests (sources, LLM); project tests still run as with `pnpm test` |        |         |
| `--sources <list>`           | comma-separated: local,github,web,all                                                         |        | `local` |
| `--allow-domain <domain...>` | allow a web domain (also needs sources.web.enabled in config)                                 |        |         |
| `--max-pages <n>`            | web page budget                                                                               |        |         |

### `veritas spec`

review the property registry

```text
veritas spec <command>
```

| Subcommand            | Description                             |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `veritas spec list`   | list properties of the latest run       |
| `veritas spec show`   |                                         |
| `veritas spec accept` |                                         |
| `veritas spec reject` |                                         |
| `veritas spec diff`   | compare properties of the last two runs |
| `veritas spec export` | print the registry as JSON              |

#### `veritas spec list`

list properties of the latest run

```text
veritas spec list
```

#### `veritas spec show`

```text
veritas spec show <id>
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `<id>`   | yes      |             |

#### `veritas spec accept`

```text
veritas spec accept <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `<id>`   | yes      |             |

| Option            | Description                                              | Values | Default      |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------ |
| `--reason <text>` | why                                                      |        | **required** |
| `--actor <name>`  | who decides (default: VERITAS_ACTOR, then git user.name) |        |              |

#### `veritas spec reject`

```text
veritas spec reject <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `<id>`   | yes      |             |

| Option            | Description                                              | Values | Default      |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------ |
| `--reason <text>` | why                                                      |        | **required** |
| `--actor <name>`  | who decides (default: VERITAS_ACTOR, then git user.name) |        |              |

#### `veritas spec diff`

compare properties of the last two runs

```text
veritas spec diff
```

#### `veritas spec export`

print the registry as JSON

```text
veritas spec export
```

### `veritas analyze`

```text

```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `[path]` | no       |             |

| Option          | Description | Values | Default |
| --------------- | ----------- | ------ | ------- |
| `--since <ref>` |             |        |         |

### `veritas mutate`

run mutation testing and relate mutants to properties

```text
veritas mutate [options]
```

| Option            | Description                                                                       | Values | Default |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------- |
| `--since <ref>`   |                                                                                   |        |         |
| `--scope <glob>`  |                                                                                   |        |         |
| `--import <file>` | normalize an existing mutation-testing-elements report instead of running mutator |        |         |
| `--kill-matrix`   | run every covering test for every mutant and report the kill matrix (slower)      |        |         |

### `veritas test`

property-based tests

```text
veritas test <command>
```

| Subcommand              | Description                                                                                                                          |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `veritas test replay`   | replay a recorded property-based test with its seed and shrink path; exit 0 when the recorded result is reproduced, 4 when it is not |
| `veritas test generate` | generate fast-check property tests for formalized properties (written under .veritas/generated-tests)                                |

#### `veritas test replay`

replay a recorded property-based test with its seed and shrink path; exit 0 when the recorded result is reproduced, 4 when it is not

```text
veritas test replay <pbt-id> [options]
```

| Argument   | Required | Description |
| ---------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `<pbt-id>` | yes      |             |

| Option           | Description                                      | Values | Default |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------ | ------- |
| `--run <run-id>` | look in this run instead of the most recent ones |        |         |

#### `veritas test generate`

generate fast-check property tests for formalized properties (written under .veritas/generated-tests)

```text
veritas test generate [options]
```

| Option            | Description                                                       | Values | Default |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------- |
| `--property <id>` |                                                                   |        |         |
| `--dry-run`       | print instead of writing                                          |        |         |
| `--force`         | replace generated files that were changed since they were written |        |         |

### `veritas prove`

verify formalized properties with an SMT solver (bounded)

```text
veritas prove [options]
```

| Option               | Description                                                | Values       | Default |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ------- |
| `--property <id>`    |                                                            |              |         |
| `--include-proposed` | also check properties that are not accepted (experimental) |              |         |
| `--engine <engine>`  |                                                            | `z3`, `lean` | `z3`    |

### `veritas improve`

plan test-only improvements (dry run, the default) or apply an approved plan in an isolated copy; exit 0 plan ready/improved, 4 no safe improvement or spec decision needed, 1 blocked, 2 bad token or CI, 3 tool error

```text
veritas improve [options]
```

| Option                 | Description                                                                       | Values | Default |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------- |
| `--include-proposed`   | also use proposed (not yet accepted) properties as the oracle                     |        |         |
| `--dry-run`            | plan and print the plan and its approval token; never writes project files        |        |         |
| `--apply`              | apply an approved plan (needs --plan and --approve; refused in CI)                |        |         |
| `--plan <id>`          | plan id printed by the dry run                                                    |        |         |
| `--approve <token>`    | approval token printed by the dry run                                             |        |         |
| `--actor <name>`       | who approves, recorded with the plan (default: VERITAS_ACTOR, then git user.name) |        |         |
| `--run <run-id>`       | plan from this run instead of the latest one                                      |        |         |
| `--max-iterations <n>` | maximum apply attempts for the plan (1-20)                                        |        |         |

| `--format <format>` |                                          | `text`, `json`, `markdown`, `html`, `sarif` |         |
| `--run <run-id>`    | report on this run instead of the latest |                                             |         |

| `--profile <profile>` |                                                                                               | `quick`, `standard`, `deep` | `standard` |
